deficiencies.description: The rewrite converts the lecturer's pointing words ('the tumor is here. This is the outer surface of the uterus') into a specific positional relationship ('lies next to') that the text does not state.
deficiencies.sourcePassage: You can see that the tumor is here. This is the outer surface of the uterus.
deficiencies.rewritePassage: The tumour lies next to the outer surface of the uterus

deficiencies.description: The word 'circumspect' in the spoken text has been altered to 'circumscribed' without an entry in the term corrections list.
deficiencies.sourcePassage: So you can see again that this is actually circumspect and very separate from the surrounding stroma and the surrounding tissue.
deficiencies.rewritePassage: The tumour is therefore circumscribed and very separate from the surrounding stroma and the surrounding tissue.

considerations.sourcePassage: So contrast this fibroid that you're seeing here, this leiomyoma, with a malignant case.
considerations.reason: Rendering 'this leiomyoma' as an appositive explaining 'This fibroid, a leiomyoma' accurately preserves the lecturer's identification of the fibroid as a leiomyoma.

considerations.sourcePassage: has, if you like, invaded within this tissue.
considerations.reason: Translating the colloquial hedge 'if you like' to 'in a sense' maintains the same meaning and hedging without altering the scientific claim.

considerations.sourcePassage: All right? So a benign tumor.
considerations.reason: Omitted conversational check and repetition of the category, which are allowed omissions of spoken discourse markers.
